actual_checks: Full exact prompt, source/meta/API records, report, notes and both full prior manuscripts read. Earlier basis/rank-one/algebraic-input, minimal-counterexample and almost-everywhere arguments are not repeated as new progress. The contribution adds two-subspace submodularity, a precise zero-defect gluing obstruction and a complete rationally-independent polynomial-exponent functional classification, labeled literature report with no numerical Schanuel claim.

For rational basis of W, all exponentials of rational combinations are algebraic over its finite field by clearing denominators, so transcendence degree is finite. F(U+V)=F(U)F(V) exactly, while only inclusion F(U intersection V) subset F(U) intersection F(V) is justified. Field transcendence-degree submodularity plus the vector-space dimension identity gives the stated unconditional inequality.

Zero-defect join/intersection equality requires nonnegative defects from Schanuel. Lines Q*1 and Q*2*pi*i both have defect zero and trivial intersection; their join defect is trdeg Q(e,pi)-2 up to algebraic adjunctions. Proving unconditional zero-defect gluing there would already solve e/pi independence; it is not inferred from submodularity.

For finitely many distinct exponential monomials, rational independence modulo constants makes every difference a nonconstant polynomial. A ray avoiding finitely many real-part-zero leading coefficients gives a unique eventual dominant exponential. Dividing by it forces a nonzero coefficient polynomial to tend to zero, contradiction. Rational dependence gives the converse algebraic relation. The nonconstant input polynomial makes t algebraic over the input field, proving total functional degree n+1. Arbitrary constants z_i+t^i and specialization at zero demonstrate why this proves no universal numerical instance.
